title: 第二十五章 离开潭杏堂第二十六章 案发
content_zh:
凌晨两点的时候，狄九回到了潭杏堂。他打算向时锦姗和斐启告辞了，同时也叮嘱时锦姗和斐启赶紧离开。以彼郑生的能量，迟早都可以查到他住在潭杏堂，甚至不用等到天亮。
潭杏堂的灯还亮着，狄九打开门进来的时候，看见时锦姗、斐启和潭月玥坐在厅里面，三人的表情都很是严肃。
狄九一进来，潭月玥就站了起来，“小九，你怎么连一个手机都没有？”
“我手机坏了，这么晚，你怎么来了？”狄九没有和潭月玥开玩笑的心思了。
“我办完事情就去了彼河大厦，没想到彼河大厦不让进去。我又打电话给苏莜，她的电话也打不通。我想要回来问问你是怎么回事，时大姐却告诉了我一件骇人听闻的事情？”潭月玥说话的时候盯着狄九。
狄九点点头，“看样子你也知道了彼河大厦地下层是太平擂台所在，既然如此，那我就将今天晚上的事情都告诉你。不要说苏莜，就是我也差点被彼郑生派的人干掉了。”
差点被干掉那是不可能的，不过狄九知道那是他练成了第一刀。换句话说如果他还是刚刚来到这里的狄九，他的确是被干掉了。
“彼郑生这么快就知道你救了启哥？”时锦姗惊慌的站了起来，心里有些愧疚。如果被彼郑生知道，那就意味着狄九将来也会和他们一样，只能过着躲藏的生活。
彼郑生的心狠手辣，她比谁都清楚。
潭月玥也惊慌的站了起来，说实在话，最初时锦姗告诉她太平擂台的事情，她是不敢相信的。她在洛津也生活了许多年，可从未听说过什么太平擂台，那种事情离开她太遥远。
狄九说道，“是的，应该是偶然泄露的，现在他们还没有找到这里来。苏莜长相可人，不知道怎么回事，被彼郑生看见了……”
狄九说到这里，突兀顿了下来。他想到了一件事，来说彼郑生之所以可以发现苏莜的可人，很有可能是因为他的缘故。
以彼郑生这种地位，绝对不会浪费时间去看一个生日舞会情况。而是因为彼郑生想要看他，结果在监控下看见了苏莜，苏莜成了被殃及的池鱼。
明白了这一点后，狄九心里更是愧疚。本来他打算就这样偷偷离开洛津，躲开彼郑生的，现在狄九的想法有了一些改变。既然苏莜父母都是因为他受累了，他应该为苏家去报这个仇。
“怎么了？”潭月玥紧张的手指都捏的有些发白了。
在听了时锦姗说太平擂台主人彼郑生的可怕之后，她才知道自己是多么的单纯。
狄九沉声说道，“彼郑生派人要带走苏莜，应该是苏莜的父亲有些手段，结果反抗之中被对方杀了。彼郑生的人索性将苏莜的母亲也杀了，直接强行带走了苏莜……”
“这些畜生……”潭月玥说完，转身就要出去。
时锦姗一把抓住了潭月玥，“你不要去报警，抓不到他的，就算是抓到他了，他的律师依然会将他保释出来。他现在的国籍不是华夏，而是意国。”
狄九叹道，“时大姐说的没错，以你现在的能力，根本就奈何不了他。苏莜都明白这个道理，你为什么就不会明白？”

“苏莜呢？”潭月玥心急苏莜，急切的问道。
狄九说道，“他们派去抓我的人被我摆脱了，然后我根据他们谈话中的联系地点找到了苏莜，救了她。现在苏莜已经去了燕京，她说要去找她姑姑。”
无论话有多少破绽，狄九是不会说他反杀了那几个家伙的。斐启和时锦姗就算了，潭月玥知道了他的事情，难保不会在调查中说出来。
本来狄九是要说他也打算走了，在知道苏莜父母受了他的连累后，他决定将账收了再走。到时候计划周详一点，未必就不能干掉彼郑生。
潭月玥听到狄九的话，眼圈通红，却也无力的坐了下来。她很清楚狄九说的对，特别是仙女星被发现然后开放之后，很多东西都在不知不觉的改变当中。
“你也打算走了？”潭月玥看着狄九问道。
“没错，我的确是打算走了，我希望你们也一起走，彼郑生迟早会找到这里来。”说完，狄九将大行门录拿了出来递给斐启，“斐兄，这个给你吧。”
这本书他还没看完，既然大家要分开，索性还给斐启。他迟早要去仙女星，等他学会狄氏七刀后，仙女星上必定可以找到类似的修道功法。
斐启伸手拦住了狄九的书，“狄兄弟，你知道这书我留在身边根本就毫无用处。你收着吧，将来看完了，如果我有后人来，你就留给我的后人。我和锦姗现在就走，将来我们有机缘再见。”
说完斐启转身就走，时锦姗也向狄九打了个招呼，一样干脆利落的跟着斐启就要走。他见多识广，做事更是不拖泥带水。
“等等……”狄九赶紧叫住了斐启，他没有将大行门录还给斐启，他明白斐启的意思。虽然是说借给他，实际上就等于送给他一样，这等于是报答他的救命之恩。
“将你的手机拿给我。”狄九说完，从怀里拿出了自己的狄氏七刀。
时锦姗疑惑的拿出了手机递给狄九，狄九用时锦姗的手机将狄氏七刀前面六刀全部拍到了时锦姗的手机中，将手机还给时锦姗道，“这也是我家传的修炼手段，你们将来可以试试看。”
之所以没有拍第七刀，是因为狄氏第七刀需要修炼完第六刀后，才可以打开。而到现在为止，狄家除了写下狄氏七刀的狄跃，还没有人能修炼到第七刀。
斐启等时锦姗接回手机，这才对狄九说道，“狄兄弟，你的确是光明磊落的汉子，我没有看错，咱们后会有期。”
潭月玥一直在边上看着狄九和斐启、时锦姗告辞，等斐启两人走后，她才说道，“狄九，虽说我不知道你为什么来我家做一个伙计，不过我肯定你将来的成就不一般。洛津不是久留之地，我也要走了，等我回到燕京后，我会将这件事告诉我爷爷。”
送走三人，狄九简单将自己的东西收拾了一下，背着自己的背包，将潭杏堂的门锁好，也是迅速离开了这里。
本来他的计划是立即离开洛津，最好的去处应该是临川。现在他改变了主意，他就算是要走，也要在临走之前做掉太平擂台和彼郑生。
别看他之前干掉了彼郑生的六个人，事实上狄九知道除了彼郑生要追杀他之外，他根本就没有事情，因为彼郑生会将这件事遮掩的严严实实。
反而是彼郑生杀了苏莜父母这件事，肯定不会小。至于彼郑生如何掩盖起来，狄九不在意，他在意的是如何干掉彼郑生。
content_en:
At two o'clock in the morning, Di Jiu returned to Tanxingtang. He planned to say goodbye to Shi Jinshan and Fei Qi, and at the same time told Shi Jinshan and Fei Qi to leave quickly. With Zheng Sheng's energy, he could find out sooner or later that he lived in Tanxingtang, without even having to wait until dawn.
The lights in Tanxing Hall were still on. When Di Jiu opened the door and came in, he saw Shi Jinshan, Fei Qi and Tan Yueyue sitting in the hall, all with serious expressions.
As soon as Di Jiu came in, Tan Yueyue stood up and said, "Xiao Jiu, why don't you even have a mobile phone?"
"My mobile phone is broken. Why are you here so late?" Di Jiu no longer had any intention of joking with Tan Yueyue.
"I went to Bihe Building after finishing my work. Unexpectedly, Bihe Building refused to allow entry. I called Su You again, but her phone number couldn't be reached either. I wanted to come back and ask you what happened, but Sister Shi told me something shocking?" Tan Yueyue stared at Di Jiu as she spoke.
Di Jiu nodded, "It seems that you also know that the basement of Bihe Building is where the Taiping Arena is. In that case, I will tell you everything that happened tonight. Not to mention Su You, I was almost killed by someone from Bi Zhengsheng's faction."
It was impossible to almost be killed, but Di Jiu knew that was the first sword he had practiced. In other words, if he was still the Di Jiu who had just arrived here, he would indeed have been killed.
"Zheng Sheng knew you had saved Brother Qi so quickly?" Shi Jinshan stood up in panic, feeling a little guilty. If Zheng Sheng knew about it, it would mean that Di Jiu would be like them in the future and could only live in hiding.
She knows Zhengsheng's ruthlessness better than anyone else.
Tan Yueyue also stood up in panic. To be honest, she couldn't believe it when Jinshan told her about Taiping Arena at first. She has lived in Luojin for many years, but she has never heard of the Taiping Arena. That kind of thing is too far away from her.
Di Jiu said, "Yes, it should have been leaked accidentally. They haven't found this place yet. Su You has a pleasant appearance. I don't know what happened, but Zheng Sheng saw him..."
When Di Jiu said this, he suddenly paused. He thought of one thing. The reason why Zheng Sheng found Su You attractive was probably because of him.
With Zheng Sheng's status, he would never waste time watching a birthday party. But because Zheng Sheng wanted to see him, he saw Su You under surveillance, and Su You became a troubled fish.
After understanding this, Di Jiu felt even more guilty. Originally, he planned to leave Luojin secretly and avoid Bi Zhengsheng, but now Di Jiu's thoughts have changed. Since Su You's parents were harmed because of him, he should avenge the Su family.
"What's wrong?" Tan Yueyue's nervous fingers turned white.
After listening to Shi Jinshan talk about how terrifying the master of the Taiping Arena was, Pi Zhengsheng, she realized how innocent she was.
Di Jiu said in a deep voice, "Zheng Sheng sent people to take Su You away. Su You's father must have some tricks, but he was killed by the other party during the resistance. Zheng Sheng's people simply killed Su You's mother and took Su You away by force..."
"These beasts..." After Tan Yueyue finished speaking, she turned around and was about to go out.
Shi Jinshan grabbed Tan Yueyue and said, "Don't go to the police. If you can't catch him, even if you catch him, his lawyer will still bail him out. His current nationality is not Chinese, but Italian."
Di Jiu sighed, "Sister Shi is right. With your current ability, you can't do anything to him. Su You understands this truth, why can't you understand it?"
"Where's Su You?" Tan Yueyue asked anxiously, worried about Su You.
Di Jiu said, "I got rid of the person they sent to arrest me, and then I found Su You based on the contact location in their conversation and rescued her. Now Su You has gone to Yanjing, and she said she wanted to find herHer aunt. "
No matter how many flaws there are in his words, Di Jiu will not say that he killed those guys instead. Forget it about Fei Qi and Shi Jinshan. Tan Yueyue knew about his affairs and there was no guarantee that he wouldn't tell them during the investigation.
Originally, Di Jiu wanted to say that he planned to leave, but after knowing that Su You's parents had been implicated by him, he decided to collect the debt before leaving. If the plan is more thorough then, it may not be impossible to kill Zheng Sheng.
When Tan Yueyue heard Di Jiu's words, her eyes were red, but she sat down helplessly. She knew very well that Di Jiu was right, especially after the Fairy Star was discovered and opened, many things were changing unknowingly.
"Are you planning to leave too? Tan Yueyue looked at Di Jiu and asked.
"Yes, I do plan to leave, and I hope you will leave together, and Zheng Sheng will find him here sooner or later. After saying that, Di Jiu took out the Da Xing Men Lu and handed it to Fei Qi, "Brother Fei, I'll give this to you." "
He hasn't finished reading this book yet. Since everyone is going to separate, he simply returns it to Fei Qi. Sooner or later he will go to Fairy Star. After he learns Di's Seven Knives, he will definitely be able to find similar cultivation techniques on Fairy Star.
Fei Qi stretched out his hand to stop Di Jiu's book, "Brother Di, you know that this book is completely useless if I keep it with me. Just keep it and read it in the future. If I have descendants, leave it to my descendants. Jinshan and I are leaving now and we will see you again in the future. "
After saying that, Fei Qi turned around and left. Shi Jinshan also said hello to Di Jiu and followed Fei Qi to leave just as neatly. He is well-informed and does things without hesitation.
"Wait..." Di Jiu quickly stopped Fei Qi. He did not return the Daxingmenlu to Fei Qi. He understood what Fei Qi meant. Although it was said that it was lent to him, it was actually the same as giving it to him. This was tantamount to repaying his life-saving grace.
“Give me your phone. "After Di Jiu finished speaking, he took out his Seven Di's Swords from his arms.
Shi Jinshan doubtfully took out her cell phone and handed it to Di Jiu. Di Jiu used Shi Jinshan's cell phone to take pictures of the first six of Di's seven swords into Shi Jinshan's cell phone. He returned the phone to Shi Jinshan and said, "This is also a cultivation method passed down from my family. You can try it in the future. "
The reason why I didn't shoot the seventh sword is because Di's seventh sword can only be opened after practicing the sixth sword. And so far, no one in the Di family has been able to practice the seventh sword except Di Yue, who wrote down Di's Seven Swords.
While Fei Qi was waiting, Jinshan took the phone back and then said to Di Jiu, "Brother Di, you are indeed an upright man. I read that right. We will meet again later. "
Tan Yueyue had been watching Di Jiu, Fei Qi, and Shi Jinshan say goodbye. After Fei Qi left, she said, "Di Jiu, although I don't know why you came to my house to be a waiter, I am sure that your future achievements will be extraordinary. Luojin is not a place to stay for a long time. I have to leave. When I return to Yanjing, I will tell my grandfather about this. "
After seeing the three people off, Di Jiu simply packed up his things, carried his backpack, locked the door of Tanxingtang, and left quickly.
His original plan was to leave Luojin immediately, and the best place to go would be Linchuan. Now he has changed his mind. Even if he wants to leave, he must kill Taiping Arena and Bi Zhengsheng before leaving.
Regardless of the fact that he had killed six of Zhengsheng's men before, in fact Di Jiu knew that apart from Zhengsheng's pursuit of him, he had nothing to do with him, because Zhengsheng would cover it up tightly.
On the contrary, the fact that Zheng Sheng killed Su You's parents is definitely not a small matter. As for how Zheng Sheng covered up, Di Jiu didn't care. What he cared about was how to kill Zheng Sheng.
